objectives.en: Say the o'clock time when the long hand is on twelve.
objectives.yo: Sọ àkókò o'clock nígbà tí ọwọ́ gígùn bá wà lórí twelve.
objectives.pcm: Talk the o'clock time when the long hand dey on twelve.

objectives.en: Know that the long hand on six means half past.
objectives.yo: Mọ̀ pé ọwọ́ gígùn lórí six túmọ̀ sí half past.
objectives.pcm: Know say when the long hand dey on six, na half past.

curriculum.strand: Mensuration and Geometry / Primary Measures / Time
curriculum.objective: Tell the time on the hour and the half hour
curriculum.note: Scheme families disagree on the term for Primary 2; term 3 is safe for Primary 3.

say.en: The school bell rings at eight o'clock. Break is half past ten. A clock tells the time.
say.pcm: School bell dey ring eight o'clock. Break na half past ten. Clock dey tell the time.
say.yo: Agogo ilé ìwé máa ń lu ní eight o'clock. Ìsinmi jẹ́ half past ten. Aago ń sọ àkókò.

say.en: Today you will look at clocks and say times.
say.pcm: Today you go look clock and talk times.
say.yo: Lónìí, ìwọ yóò wo aago kí o sọ àkókò.

say.en: Let us name three days. Say Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.
say.pcm: Make we name three days. Talk Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká sọ ọjọ́ mẹ́ta. Sọ Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.

say.en: The short hand shows hours, the long hand minutes. Long hand on twelve is o'clock. On six, half past.
say.pcm: Clock get short and long hands. Short hand dey show hour, long hand dey show minutes. Twelve mean o'clock, and six mean half past.
say.yo: Aago ní ọwọ́ kúkúrú àti gígùn. Ọwọ́ kúkúrú ń fi wákàtí hàn, ọwọ́ gígùn sì ń fi ìṣẹ́jú hàn. Twelve túmọ̀ sí o'clock, six sì túmọ̀ sí half past.

say.en: Let us read one: long hand is on twelve. Short hand is on two. Say two o'clock with me.
say.pcm: Make we read one: long hand dey on twelve. Short hand dey on two. Say am with me: two o'clock.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká ka ọ̀kan: ọwọ́ gígùn wà lórí twelve. Ọwọ́ kúkúrú wà lórí two. Sọ two o'clock pẹ̀lú mi.

say.en: Your turn. Long hand on twelve, short hand on three. What time is it?
say.pcm: Na your turn. Long hand dey twelve, short hand dey three. Which time be that?
say.yo: Ìwọ náà. Ọwọ́ gígùn lórí twelve, ọwọ́ kúkúrú lórí three. Àkókò wo ni?

say.en: Look at the short hand again. It names the hour. Long hand on twelve says o'clock.
say.pcm: Look the short hand again. E name the hour. Long hand for twelve talk o'clock.
say.yo: Tún wo ọwọ́ kúkúrú. Ó ń sọ wákàtí. Ọwọ́ gígùn lórí twelve ń sọ o'clock.

say.en: Let us see what you remember. Long hand on twelve, short hand on five. What time is it?
say.pcm: Make we see wetin you remember. Long hand dey twelve, short hand dey five. Which time be that?
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká wo ohun tí o rántí. Ọwọ́ gígùn lórí twelve, ọwọ́ kúkúrú lórí five. Àkókò wo ni?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we tell time again. Next we learn half past four.
say.pcm: Well done. Tomorrow we go tell time again. Next we learn half past four.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún sọ àkókò. Lẹ́yìn náà, a ó kọ́ half past four.
